title: 第2章 执念：丁守成
content_zh:
【任务目标：以任何方式摧毁断绝八宝金身传承】

    【任务奖励：天地奇物一份，天材地宝一份】

    【时间：7天】

    -----------------

    魏乐府揉了揉太阳穴，就在刚才，他经历了一名叫做丁守成的人的一生。

    丁守成是四方武馆的馆主孟惟的亲传弟子，排行第三。

    大师兄是孟惟的儿子，是内定的继承人。

    二师兄是本地最大豪门世家的公子哥，属于人情世故的挂名。

    而丁守成则是被自小收养来的孤儿。

    倒不是孟惟心地善良，而是丁守成根骨奇佳，是一块练武的上好材料。

    之所以收养他，自然是为了来日辅佐自己的儿子能够维系好武馆。

    不得不说，孟惟的打压教育非常成功，丁守成确实按着他的方式成长了起来，并且被控制得非常稳固。

    丁守成为人老实木讷，武馆里他干的活最多，好处拿的最少。

    被控制的丁守成也没有什么怨言，有口饭吃就行了。

    然而一切就戛然而止了，记忆停留在了他像条死狗一样被扔在柴房里等死。

    结果不言而喻，丁守成肯定是死了。

    他要是不死，魏乐府怎么替代丁守成？

    在魏乐府完成替代后，一道执念浮现出来。

    【丁守成：我想换一种活法】

    【汝所承为执念，人死债消，无需牵绊被替代者因果过往、恩怨情仇】

    对于魏乐府来说，执念非常含糊。

    不过对于下面的提示，魏乐府却感觉到有趣。

    意思就是他只是一个替代者，不要真把自己代入已经死了的被替代者身上。

    事实上，魏乐府也压根没有什么代入感。

    丁守成的死亡原因不是内脏破裂就是严重内出血，而伤势的来源自然是比武里被人打出来的。

    但是魏乐府替代他之后并没有这些症状。

    也正是因为和过去切割了，所以他才没事。

    不然真要身受重伤，那还怎么完成任务和了结执念。

    魏乐府爬了起来，活动了一下身子。
content_en:
[Mission goal: Destroy and cut off the inheritance of the Eight Treasures Golden Body by any means]

    [Task reward: one piece of wonders from heaven and earth, one piece of heavenly materials and earthly treasures]

    [Time: 7 days]

    ------------------

    Wei Yuefu rubbed his temples. Just now, he experienced the life of a man named Ding Shoucheng.

    Ding Shoucheng is the direct disciple of Meng Wei, the master of Sifang Martial Arts School, and ranks third.

    The eldest brother is Meng Wei's son and the unofficial heir.

    The second senior brother is the son of the largest wealthy family in the local area, and he has a reputation for being worldly and sophisticated.

    Ding Shoucheng is an orphan who was adopted since childhood.

    It's not that Meng Wei is kind-hearted, but that Ding Shoucheng has extremely good bones and is a good material for martial arts training.

    The reason why he was adopted was naturally so that he could assist his son in maintaining the martial arts school in the future.

    It has to be said that Meng Wei's suppressive education was very successful. Ding Shoucheng did grow up in his way and was controlled very firmly.

    Ding Shoucheng was an honest and dull person. He did the most work in the martial arts gym and received the least benefits.

    Ding Shoucheng, who was controlled, had no complaints, as long as he had something to eat.

    However, everything stopped suddenly, and the memory stayed in him being thrown into the woodshed to die like a dead dog.

    The result is self-evident, Ding Shoucheng must be dead.

    If he didn't die, how could Wei Yuefu replace Ding Shoucheng?

    After Wei Yuefu completed the replacement, an obsession emerged.

    [Ding Shoucheng: I want to change my way of living]

    [The obsession you have inherited, the debt will be eliminated after death, and there is no need to tie up the cause and effect of the person being replaced, the past, the grudges and the grudges]

    For Wei Yuefu, obsession is very vague.

    However, Wei Yuefu found the following prompt interesting.

    This means that he is just a substitute, don't really put yourself into the dead substitute.

    In fact, Wei Yuefu has no sense of immersion at all.

    The cause of Ding Shoucheng's death was either internal rupture or severe internal bleeding, and the source of his injuries was naturally from being beaten during the competition.

    But Wei Yuefu did not have these symptoms after replacing him.

    It was precisely because he was cut off from the past that he was fine.

    Otherwise, how can we complete the mission and end our obsession if we are really seriously injured?

    Wei Yuefu got up and moved his body.
